content: Hi! How can I help you today? Looking to share or find a file?
Yes, could you help me organize the meeting materials for our team? I have the recording and slides.

Absolutely! I suggest creating a shared folder called "Team Meeting June 2024". Inside, place the recording and slides, naming them like 'Recording_v1.mp4' and 'Slides_v1.pdf' keeps things tidy for everyone.
That sounds good. Should I share the folder with just view access?
Great question. Yes, view-only access is best for privacy, unless someone needs to upload. You can send the link to the team, and they can browse or download files they need.
Just uploaded both files. Should I add captions to the recording?
That's very thoughtful! Adding captions or a simple summary helps everyone, especially for accessibility. Just click 'Edit captions' on the recording, and enter a brief description or subtitles.
Done! I also added basic alt text to the slide deck.
Perfect touch! Now, encourage your teammates to click into the folder, browse the files, and download anything they want to save. Maybe add a short note about the captions and alt text you included.
Will do. Should I update the file names if changes are made later?
Yes, just add a version number, like 'Slides_v2.pdf', so everyone knows which is the latest. Keeping older versions in the folder can help track changes, too.
Thanks! I'll share the folder link with the team now.
You're welcome! Let your team know to visit the folder, browse the updated materials, and download originals as needed. Let me know if you'd like more organizing tips!
